ancient-oak.notes: Chunky lobed canopy and root-flared trunk read clearly as a hero oak at 128 px in all eight sprite directions. Palette matches the canopy and bark contract; the root flare is one-sided but stays within the chunky chibi style.

campfire.notes: Stone ring, charred logs, and teardrop flame read instantly as a campfire at 128 px, and the gray stones match the contract. The flame emissive runs pale peach instead of the contract #ff9a3c orange, so the map's warm focal accent is weaker than specified.

fallen-log.notes: Hollow opening, growth-ring end, moss patches, and branch stubs read as a mossy hollow log at 128 px. Browns match the wood contract and the piece matches the anchor log; the top stubs sit slightly peg-like but stay in style.
